qualifier: receptor classes A, B, F, H
name: Scavenger receptor-mediated ligand uptake and clearance
rationale: All four members are ligand scavenging by scavenger receptor classes A, B, F and H, unlike the monocyte identity, chemotaxis and activation modules in the confusables.

qualifier: sterol and quinone (ubiquinone, vitamin K) branches
name: Mevalonate pathway to sterols and isoprenoid quinones
rationale: Members cover the mevalonate/isoprenoid pathway (IPP, FPP, GGPP) and its sterol (lanosterol, Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell) and quinone (ubiquinol, vitamin K) products, distinguishing it from peroxisomal fatty acid, dolichol and bile acid themes.

qualifier: distal branching, saccular and alveolar epithelial stages
name: Lung branching, saccular and alveolar epithelial development
rationale: Members are lung morphogenesis steps (branching, lobe, saccule, vasculature, pneumocyte I/II differentiation, lung growth), lacking the surfactant and trachea members of the confusables.

name: Selenium and sulfide metabolism and cofactor activation
rationale: Members are inorganic chalcogen metabolism (dietary selenium compounds to H2Se and excretion, hydrogen sulfide oxidation, cysteine catabolism) plus prosthetic-group synthesis, distinct from the transsulfuration and glutathione confusables.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members are neuropeptide (orexin, NPFF, QRFP, opioid) GPCR signalling and the sleep/wake, nerve-transmission and stress behaviours it controls; sleep/wake members distinguish it from the mating, aggression and CRH-stress confusables.

name: FcεRI-mediated mast cell activation and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are FcεRI signalling (Ca2+, MAPK, NF-kB), mast cell degranulation, cytokine output and differentiation, and hypersensitivity reactions, unlike the Th2/eosinophil and Fc-gamma receptor confusables.

name: Olfaction, pheromone response and sour taste perception
rationale: Members are smell, odorant receptors, pheromone response and sour taste detection, while the confusables carry sweet, bitter, umami and salty taste or TRP/acid-sensing channels.

name: Cellular iron import and systemic iron homeostasis
rationale: All members concern iron ion import, transmembrane transport and organismal iron homeostasis, distinct from transferrin cycling, heme synthesis and erythrocyte gas transport confusables.

name: Potassium-channel repolarization of cardiac action potential
rationale: Members are cardiac action potential phases 1-4 and atrial/ventricular repolarization with Kv, Kir and TWIK potassium channels, whereas confusables carry phase 0 depolarization, conduction system and other K+ channel families.

qualifier: transcriptional activation of apoptosis and G1 arrest
name: p53 transcriptional activation of apoptosis and G1 arrest
rationale: Members are TP53 transcriptional targets in cell death and G1 arrest (p21, caspases, death receptors) plus positive regulation of p53 apoptosis and its expression and cofactors, unlike confusables on p14ARF/p16 defects, p53 phosphorylation/degradation and negative regulation.

qualifier: ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO receptors via Rho GTPases
name: Ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO axon guidance via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members are ephrin, netrin/DCC and SLIT-ROBO guidance signalling and the RAC1/CDC42/RHOA switching they drive, distinct from semaphorin, L1 and commissural midline confusables.

name: HIV-1 pre-integration complex nuclear import and integration
rationale: Members are post-reverse-transcription HIV-1 steps (Vpr-mediated PIC import, integration, autointegration, 2-LTR circles, APOBEC3G restriction), unlike entry/reverse transcription and latency confusables.

qualifier: restraint by KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxicity checked by KIR-MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members combine granzyme killing and NK degranulation with KIR, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing, versus confusables on NK activation, cytokine production and cell signatures.

name: Protein lysine trimethylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: Members are protein methylation and hydroxylation (peptidyl-lysine trimethylation and hydroxylation, proline modification), unlike tRNA and translation-factor modification or arginine/mono-dimethylation confusables.

name: Negative-strand RNA virus (influenza, RSV) replication and transcription
rationale: Members are influenza vRNP synthesis, import, export and host evasion plus RSV genome transcription, replication and assembly, unlike the SARS-CoV and HIV confusables.

name: Stromal fibroblast adhesion, matrix and KRAS/AP-1 target genes
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal matrix and adhesion gene sets with fibroblast proliferation, KRAS-up and FOSL1/2 targets, differing from the YAP/TGF-beta, pure ECM and endothelial confusables.

name: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter-mediated calcium uptake
rationale: All three members concern calcium import into mitochondria via the uniporter (SMDT1/EMRE processing), unlike the mitochondrial protein import and degradation confusables.

qualifier: IL-10/IL-12 families, IL-15/21, type III interferon; NK/NKT
name: IL-10/IL-12-family, IL-15/21 and interferon-lambda signalling; NK/NKT regulation
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35, IL-15, IL-21 and type III/alpha interferon signalling with NK and NKT cell regulation, unlike the Th2/IL-6/mast cell, IL-17/IL-33 and NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: dendritic spines and arbors via postsynaptic actin
name: Dendritic spine and arbor structural plasticity via postsynaptic actin
rationale: Members regulate dendritic spine morphogenesis and maintenance, dendrite arborization, postsynaptic actin and density organization and reelin signalling, unlike the synapse-adhesion, LTP/memory and Rho GTPase confusables.

name: Striated muscle excitation-contraction coupling, cardiac conduction and calcium handling
rationale: Members span cardiac action potential phases, conduction and gap junctions, ion channels and sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release/uptake controlling contraction, unlike cAMP/adrenergic, K+ homeostasis and muscle growth confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and regulation of proteasomal protein turnover
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal/ubiquitin-dependent degradation and protein destabilization together with stress granule assembly, disassembly and PKR signalling, the latter absent from the ubiquitination and PML confusables.

name: Epithelial and endothelial cell-cell junctions, polarity and EMT
rationale: Members are adherens, tight, desmosome and hemidesmosome junctions, cadherin adhesion, apical/basal polarity, barrier and EMT, unlike mechanosensing, ECM/integrin, leading-edge and cornification confusables.

name: Zinc sensing by MTF1 and metallothionein metal binding
rationale: All three members concern zinc response via MTF1 and metallothionein metal binding, distinct from ROS detoxification and cadmium/heavy-metal confusables.

name: Dietary lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid digestion, intestinal absorption, acylglycerol transport and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, versus bile acid and lipoprotein remodeling/clearance confusables.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, cell death, HSE deficiencies
name: TLR3-TRIF signalling to IRF3 and necroptosis; HSE deficiencies
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3 trafficking, TRIF-TBK1-IRF3/7 activation, TRIF-mediated necroptotic death and TLR3-pathway herpes encephalitis deficiencies, unlike the TLR7/8/9 IRAK and RIPK1 confusables.
